(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A method, comprising: inputting database constructs generated by a database optimizer as an input to a trained machine-learning algorithm; obtaining an estimated database operation predictor from the machine-learning algorithm as an output; modifying at least one of the database constructs based on the estimated database operation predictor producing a modified database construct; and processing a database operation with the database constructs and the modified database construct.

(Currently Amended) Claim 10: The method of claim 1 further comprising, storing the estimated database operation predictor in database statistics associated with the database operation and the database constructs.

(Currently Amended) Claim 12: A method comprising: training a machine-learning algorithm with database constructs produced by a database optimizer; receiving query execution plans for a query from the database optimizer with a least cost query execution plan identified by the database optimizer for the query; providing the query execution plans as input to the machine-learning algorithm; obtaining as an output a predicted execution time for the query based on the least cost query execution plan; and modifying one of: the least cost query execution plan for the query, a scheduled execution time for the query, and resources that are used to execute the query based on the predicted execution time, wherein at least one of the modifications includes updating the database constructs associated with the query. 

(Currently Amended) Claim 18: The method of claim 12, wherein modifying further includes changing an execution resource of the least cost query execution plan based on the predicted query execution time, user workload performance, and a current performance associated with the execution resource. 

(Currently Amended) Claim 19: A system, comprising: a database management system; at least one hardware processor; a non-transitory computer-readable storage medium having executable instructions representing a trained machine-learning algorithm; the machine learning algorithm configured to execute on the at least one hardware processor from the non-transitory computer-readable storage medium and to perform processing to: i) receive as input database constructs produced by a database optimizer for a database operation of the database management system; and ii) provide as output a predicted execution value relevant to one or more of the database constructs and the database operation; wherein the database management system is configured to process the predicted execution value to determine whether to modify one of: the one or more database constructs and the database operation before processing the database operation within the database management system. 

(Currently Amended) Claim 20: The system of claim 19, wherein the predicted execution value is an estimated query execution time for a query and the database operation is execution of a query execution plan for the query within the database management system, wherein the predicted execution time is adjusted based on historical performance data related to similar queries.
